chapter.verse: Pilna a nei lo Galati mite aw, singlamteh tungah sihna a thuak Zeisu Khazih in no mai-ah a tel takin hong kilak napi-in, note a kua in hong bum hiam?
Thukham zuihna hangin Kha Siangtho na ngah uh hiam, ahih kei leh, upna thu na ngahna uh hangin na ngah uh hiam ci-in thu khat bek note kiangah ka thei nuam hi.
Hih zah takin pilna nei lo na hi uh hiam? Kha Siangtho suangin na kipat khit uh ciangin ci-le-sa suangin na tangtun’ zo ding uh hiam?
Hih zah tak gimna a mawkna-in na thuak uh hiam? A mawkna taktak ding ahi hiam?
Tua tham loin, Kha Siangtho note hong pia a, note lakah nalamdang hong lakpa in Thukham na zuihna hangun hong bawl ahi hiam, ahih kei leh, upna thu na ngaihna hang bek uh ahi hiam?
Tua bangin “Abraham in Pasian um a, a upna hangin Pasian in amah midikin a sang hi,” Lai Siangtho in a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin upna a nei mite in Abraham’ suante taktak ahi uh na thei un.

Pasian in upna tawh Gentail mite’ dikkisakna a kipsak hi ci-in Lai Siangtho in thei kholin, Abraham kiangah, “Nangmah hangin mi pawl khempeuh in thupha a ngah ding uh hi,” ci-in Lungdamna Thu a na hilh khol hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thu-upna a nei mite in a um Abraham tawh thupha a ngah khawm uh hi.

Thukham tawh kipawl gamtatna a suang mi khempeuh in hamsiatna nuai-a om mi ahi uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Thukham laibu sungah a kigelh thu khempeuh a zui tawntung lo mi khempeuh in hamsiatna a thuak uh hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh hi.
Thukham zuihna hangin mi khat beek in Pasian mai-ah diktansakna a ngah kei hi cih tel takin a kilang hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Midik in thu upna tawh a nungta ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.

Thukham in upna tawh a kikum kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Tua gamtatna a gamta mi in tua gamtatna hangin a nungta ding hi,” ci-in kigelh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian mai-ah Thukham hangin kuamah in diktan’sakna a ngah zo kei ding hi.

“Sing khuam tungah kikhaina a thuak mi khempeuh in hamsiatna a thuak mi ahi uh hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin Khazih in eite tang dingin hamsiatna a thuak ciangin Thukham’ hamsiatna pan eite a hong tankhia zo hi.
Tua in Khazih Zeisu hangin Abraham’ thupha in Gentailte tungah a tun’ na’ng ahi zongin, eite in thu-upna hanga Kha Siangtho tawh kipawl thuciamna i ngah na’ng ahi hi.
Ute naute aw, leitung mi bangin thu ka geninah, mi ahih hangin kiciamnate a kibawl khit ciangin kuamah in a paaikhia thei kei a, kuamah in behlapin thu a guang thei kei hi.

Thuciamna Abraham leh a suan a khakte tungah a koih zo hi. “A suan a khakte,” ci-in mi tampite ngaihsunin thu a pia kei hi. “Nangma suan mi khat bek,” ci-in ngaihsunin thu a pia hi. Tua mi khat in Khazih ahi hi.
Ke’n kong cih inah, Pasian in a kipsak kiciamna kum zali leh kum sawmthum khit ciangin a piangkik Thukham in a mawkna a suah nadingin a paaikhia ahi kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, innluahna in thukham tawh kipawl ahih leh, kiciamna thu tawh kipawl lo hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in Abraham kiangah kiciamna hangin tua luahna a pia zo hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Thukhamna in a bang phatuam ahi hiam? Kiciamna a ngah a suan a khakte a hong pai matengin khialhna hangah a pia thuah hi. Tua thukham in vantungmite hangah sepkhiat dingin a kikham mi’ khut ah a kikoih hi.
A kikham mi in lang khat bek tawh a kipawl kei hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in khat bek ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Thukham in Pasian’ thukhamnate lang khatah om ahi hiam? Tua bang hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nuntakna a pia thei thukham a om leh, a man takpi tua thu hangin dikna kingah zo hi.
Tu-in ahih leh, a um mite in Zeisu Khazih upna tawh kipawl kiciamna a ngah nadingun Lai Siangtho in na khempeuhte mawhna sungah a khakcip hi.
Upna thu hong tun’ma-in eite in thukham nuaiah ukna thuakin i om a, a nung ciangin a kilang ding upna lamenin kikhum cipna thuakin i om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in upna hangin diktan’sakna i ngah nadingin Thukham in eite Khazih kiangah hong kha dingin eite hong cingpa a suak hi.
Tu-in ahih leh, upna thu hong tung ahih ciangin tua hong cing khut nuaiah i om nawn kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note khempeuh in Khazih Zeisu upna hangin Pasian’ tate na hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih sungah bataizna a ngah mi khempeuh in Khazih a silh uh hi.

Khazih Zeisu sungah Judah mi a om kei, Grik mi a om kei, sila a om kei, sila lo a om kei, pasal a om kei, numei a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih Zeisu sungah note khempeuh in pum khat bek na hi uh hi.
Note in Khazih aa na hi uh leh, Abraham suan leh khakte na hi uh a, thuciamna bangin innluah mi na hi uh hi.
